messages.subject: QCA question
parts:
Hello all,

I am quite a beginner in QCA and have a question regarding the conditions of fsQCA.

Is it possible, in an fsQCA analysis, to have a dichotomous variable among other fuzzified data? Would that mess with the construction of the truth table of the consistency scores?


I haven't found the answer for this in literature yet, so I'm sorry if this is a very obvious question.


thank you!

messages.author: a98c47479ea6b61f
messages.subject: Re: [QCA] QCA question
parts:
Hello Andreea,

Yes, it is possible. I noticed myself this is not made sufficiently obvious in the literature (and plan to amend my book accordingly) but otherwise there is nothing to prevent a QCA analysis with any combination of crisp sets, multi-value sets and fuzzy sets within the same analysis.
The QCA package in R is specifically designed to automatically detect and cope with all of these different types of conditions and constructs the truth table accordingly.

Best wishes, I hope this helps,
Adrian
